# OMP Session Gateway

> Native integration with stock Oh My Pi (OMP) >=18.1.20. No OMP fork, custom build,
> gateway-specific OMP plugin, or publisher credential. Stable v0.5.3 is published as immutable
> GitHub Latest. Keep using OMP in the terminal; the separate gateway discovers collaboration-enabled
> sessions and opens OMP's own encrypted View/Control client from an Android-first PWA. One-time
> setup requires collab.autoStart, Bun 1.4.0, gateway installation, and TUN-mode Tailscale Serve
> with Funnel disabled. No per-session QR scan or link copy. Community project; not affiliated
> with or endorsed by the Oh My Pi maintainers.

## Current qualification boundary

- Stable v0.5.3 (source 54356c80b21e101c25eca9be8119d4ffe62d50c9) was promoted from signed candidate v0.5.3-prealpha.1 with identical runtime bytes. All seven qualification lanes passed on 2026-09-24 against stock OMP v18.3.0 with no failed attempt; the artifacts lane records a second attempt because the orchestrator was relaunched during it. No claim for arbitrary builds from main.
- Exact OMP v18.3.0 source: 62bc57be1b03ef0802a33cf7f5f530e534527531. Set only collab.autoStart (off/view/control); start participating sessions with plain omp. The gateway reads OMP discovery and queries each host; OMP does not register with the gateway.
- Debian 13 (trixie) x86-64, Linux 6.12.94+deb13-amd64: 83/83 migration/recovery invariants, stock OMP publication/revocation, persistence, tagged-identity denial/exposure, uninstall and resource teardown.
- Mac14,3 / macOS 26.6.1 arm64: doctor 18/18, rollback 23/23, install/rotation/reboot-to-login persistence, real allowlisted identity and forged-header/exposure checks. Positive allowed-user HTTPS was measured on Mac/Pixel, not the tagged Debian CI caller.
- Pixel 10 Pro / Android 17 build CP2A.260805.005 / Chrome 153.0.8010.52: View read-only, Control writable, prompt accepted, return to directory; same-page recovery measured at a 250 ms probe cadence: unlock 5,866 ms (including device wake), Airplane 7,006 ms, Doze 286 ms; all seven forbidden capability sinks detectable and clean.
- Tailscale Serve over tailnet HTTPS only, TUN mode required, Funnel disabled. Fresh relay check: 1,800 seconds (2026-09-24T11:31:08.494Z–12:01:08.504Z), two transitions, final phase live. The founder renewed the 30-minute check in place of eight hours; eight-hour endurance was not rerun or claimed, no historical endurance transfers, and residual prolonged-operation risk is accepted. No bounded-memory-growth claim is made.
- Windows OMP, background Web Push, specialized attention and branch/resume, and new media qualification remain unqualified/unadvertised. Seeded-fixture product media is not release-qualification evidence for these lanes. Android radio changes can still wedge Chrome; the proven same-page recoveries do not remove that limit.
- v0.5.2 is the migration/rollback predecessor. It renders OMP 18.3.0's wait tool calls as generic tool cards. Gateway rollback does not switch OMP.
- In v0.5.0 and earlier, the first visit after a gateway upgrade can navigate a pending launch or an open View/Control page back to the directory: the service worker cannot see that a page is in use because Chromium reports each page's creation URL. The first post-release View/Control smoke failures match this navigation. The v0.5.1 fix never navigates from the worker.
- The v0.5.3 published-byte local/Pixel smoke passed on its first attempt across the upgrade from v0.5.2, against stock OMP 18.3.0. The v0.5.2 smoke passed on its second attempt across the upgrade from v0.5.1.

## Fork-era release history

- v0.3.0 requires its exact patched OMP v18.1.14 and matching historical instructions. Its qualification does not transfer to the mainline architecture.
